content.comment_body: Is it possible to use the [product_name] expansion module to enable communication with a mobile device? Regards, [user_name]

This functionality is not supported by [product_name]. Using [version_no]: A standard expansion module is not used for mobile device communication; instead, you would connect a GSM mobile device (such as a TC35) directly to a port on the CPU, for example port0 or port1. The connection is established via a PPI cable.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is exploring whether the [product_name] expansion module enables communication to mobile devices.
